We skipped 5 previously so it will be treated the same as the H3 above since it was the next lowest header that was to be decremented

name: Handles change from decrement to regular increment
Handles a variety of changes in header size
H1s become H2s and all other headers are shifted accordingly when an H1 starts a file
When H1 does not start the file, H1s are converted to H2 where they are and the next header is an H3
When H1 does not exist in the file, the minimum header is an H2 and incrementing starts from that level
